chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan ibn Musa al-Khashshab, from Ghiyath ibn Kalub al-Bajali, from Ishaq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That Ali (peace be upon him) found pieces of a dead body, they were gathered together, then he prayed over them, then they were buried.
ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali (peace be upon him) handle the funeral prayer for scattered pieces of a body?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the practical jurisprudence of *Salat al-Mayyit* (funeral prayer) by demonstrating that the prayer is valid even when the body is not intact, as Imam Ali (AS) prayed over scattered fragments before burial. It underscores the Shia scholarly view that the sanctity of the deceased remains regardless of physical fragmentation, reinforcing the ritual's role in honoring the soul rather than merely processing the corpse. This incident serves as a foundational precedent for cases where bodies are recovered in pieces or buried in multiple locations.
